additional_info.subject: From customer
additional_info.body:
Hello,
In the logs, two transactions have been looping since 13/12: [Requested ZVT Partial-Reversal 06 23: amount 2988 EUR, receipt 2395] and [Requested ZVT Partial-Reversal 06 23: amount 4288 EUR, receipt 2394] [Partial reversal returned with {"status":"error","message":"Could not convert receipt number to TA number"] Receipt 2394: Started on 13/12 at 02:07 to 02:41, ID tag EMVS40800591004241 / 7.12 EUR Receipt 2395: Started on 13/12 at 22:56 to 14/12 at 00:33, ID tag EMVS40800591004243 / 20.12 EUR On PAYONE,
both receipts show a pre-authorization but no cancellation or reversal. No funds have been credited to our account. The issue seems to occur when the telecollection process (end-of -day reconciliation) starts while a transaction is ongoing, causing the system to fail in finalizing it.
This has resulted in a financial loss. Could you please investigate the cause and confirm how we can resolve this and recover the missing funds?

additional_info.body:
Hello,
Thank you for your response.
I believe the issue might not be related to the proposed explanation, as we observe the same behavior even with successful transactions and we are billed.
For example, the following log line appears consistently:
OCPP: Send result: DataTransfer (638700370925547213-8b4c9) - {"status":"Rejected"}
Below are screenshots of a successful transaction:
Start of the transaction:
End of the transaction:
I’ve also attached a screenshot from Payone confirming that the transaction was successfully completed, and we were billed, even though the "DataTransfer rejected" message was logged:
However, the ticket shows that both transactions kept looping.
Additionally, when reviewing the logs from other days, we notice that after each tag ID authorization, this line appears:
OCPP: Send result: DataTransfer (638700370925547213-8b4c9) - {"status":"Rejected"}
Based on these observations, it seems that the issue arises when the telecollection process starts during an ongoing transaction, which may prevent the system from properly finalizing it.
Feel free to reach out if you need additional information or if you’d like to review other transactions—both successful and unsuccessful—to confirm whether they were billed or not.

additional_info.subject: Status Update
additional_info.body:
If the transaction has not been stopped before Reconcilation at 2AM, then it will be closed then and any subsequent partial reversal will fail.
For example in the case of receiptNumber
2394
, the charging was stopped at
2024.12.13 01:41
, but because OCPP went offline exactly at around that time, it did not close on the server, reconciliation happened at
2AM
and then at
2024.12.13 4AM
the OCPP server sent down a command to close the transaction, which resulted in an error.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396143-DC/Si-D/FR-[OEAo0a]-payment stuck CRM:01282000725
additional_info.body:
Dear
Chetouah Hadjar,
I hope all is well with you. Please be aware that the pending transaction has been cleared from the charger, and the credit card terminal is no longer stuck. I am proceeding to close the issue as it has been resolved.
Root cause of the issue:
receipt Number 2394, the charging was stopped at 2024.12.13 01:41, but because OCPP went offline exactly at around that time, it did not close on the server, reconciliation happened at 2AM and then at 2024.12.13 4AM the OCPP server sent down a command to close the transaction, which resulted in an error.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
